question.worked_solution:
First, we apply the distributive law:

$$
\begin{aligned}2(\frac{3x}{4}+2y)+\frac{5x}{2} & = \\ 2\cdot \frac{3x}{4}+2\cdot 2y+\frac{5x}{2} & = \\ \frac{6x}{4}+4y+\frac{5x}{2} & = \\ \frac{3x}{2}+4y+\frac{5x}{2} & \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect and combine the like terms, simplifying the coefficients as much as possible:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3x}{2}+4y+\frac{5x}{2} & = \\ (\frac{3x}{2}+\frac{5x}{2})+4y & = \\ \frac{3x+5x}{2}+4y & = \\ \frac{8x}{2}+4y & = \\ 4\,x+4\,y\end{aligned}
$$
